headline: Mooring Line Gives Ground as Farranac Base War Rekindles
war_summary: Since our last edition the base war has shifted west. Farranac Coast, dormant through the morning, broke out anew with three exchanges in the final two hours, the last logged minutes before this edition closed; twelve actions on the day, ten of them about Transient Valley, have left all eleven posts in Colonial colors. On the Mooring front the line has loosened further — nine Wardens' posts stand against three Colonials', five exchanges came in the last two hours, and Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut remain the contested points. The Weathered Expanse, by contrast, has paused: no base actions in two hours, though its casualty ledger stays the war's heaviest at a combined rate near two thousand an hour. Stlican Shelf still smolders about Fort Hoarfrost, the split holding at five Wardens to four Colonials. Stonecradle, after seventeen daybreak exchanges, has been silent since mid-morning. Callahan's Passage logs no base actions yet bleeds at the sharpest rising rate on the map, and the Nevish Line's casualty trend climbs without base movements. It is the 359th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
